title: Pakistan's First Astronaut Boards China's Space Station on Shenzhou-24
hook: Tiangong has been Chinese-only since 2022. Not anymore.
description: China launched the Shenzhou-24 spacecraft on Wednesday, carrying Pakistani astronaut Muhammad Zeeshan Ali to the Tiangong space station — the first foreign astronaut ever to board it, and the first Pakistani in orbit. Ali, a 40-year-old Pakistan Air Force pilot flying as payload specialist, entered Tiangong with commander Tang Hongbo and flight engineer Wu Yi, and will spend about a week on board before returning on Shenzhou-23. Narrated summary by Global News Shorts, based on Reuters and Associated Press reporting.
source: Global News Shorts — based on Reuters and AP reporting · Photo: Forrest XYC, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons (file photo)

title: Two Italians Killed in Drone Attack on Kuwait Air Defence Site as Iran Denies Role
hook: A drone attack in Kuwait has killed two Europeans — and the war is widening.
description: Two Italian technicians working for Rheinmetall Italia were killed in a drone attack on an air defence station in Kuwait on Thursday. Italy and Kuwait blame Iran, which denies involvement. Two other people were wounded. Narrated summary by Global News Shorts, based on Reuters and BBC reporting. File photo: Kuwait City skyline by Zairon, CC BY 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons.
source: Global News Shorts — based on Reuters and BBC reporting · Photo: Zairon, CC BY 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons (file photo)

title: Judges Urge Prosecutors to Drop Bribery Charge in Netanyahu Corruption Trial
hook: The judges say the bribery charge against Israel's prime minister is unlikely to stick.
description: Judges in Benjamin Netanyahu's corruption trial have recommended prosecutors drop the bribery charge in Case 4000, saying the chances of conviction are low, and reconsider a second case. The recommendation is not a ruling, and the attorney general says she will review it. Narrated summary by Global News Shorts, based on Reuters and Globes reporting.
source: Global News Shorts — based on Reuters and Globes reporting

title: EU Leaders Fail to Agree 2028–2034 Budget as Ukraine Loan Talks Stall
hook: After twelve hours of talks, Europe's leaders left Brussels with no budget — and Ukraine's loan still undecided.
description: EU leaders ended a special summit in Brussels without agreement on the bloc's 2028–2034 budget, after more than 12 hours of talks. A proposed €45 billion loan for Ukraine in 2027 also remains undecided, though 24 of the 27 member states back it. Leaders will try again on December 17–18. Narrated summary by Global News Shorts, based on Associated Press and Komersant reporting. File photo: the Europa building in Brussels by Olnnu, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons.
